blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo big man Sultan Baruwa had one of his best games of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday. Baruwa’s breakout couldn’t have come at a better time and place, as it fueled the squad’s 75-72 win over Far Eastern University at their home court at Blue Eagle Gym. Veteran guard Jared Bahay said that Baruwa was extra determined to help the Blue Eagles end a three-game losing slide. “I just asked him, ‘What can you help with on this team?’ He said his defense and rebounding,” revealed Bahay.
